svg.title: One slab-ocean step: which switch selects which path, and what is returned
svg.desc: Flow chart of one slab-ocean step. Switches: sea-coupling interval N changes only dt_mix; presence of the 3-D ocean selects whether Q_deep comes from the 3-D step or is zero; prognostic_ocean=0 replaces the final SST by climatology, otherwise the mixed-layer budget runs; flux_correction=1 adds a Newtonian restoring flux with separate ice-state paths. The main sequence computes heat capacity and dt_mix, the deep-ocean flux, the explicit mixed-layer budget for ice-free and ice-covered points, the freezing-point handoff, and the final SST source, then returns T_o and Q_o→i to the sea ice. For ice-covered points Q_o→i is Q_i→o plus Q_deep, where Q_i→o is the freezing-point conductive flux Q_f, zero once the slab sits at T_f. The atmospheric flux Q_a reaches the slab only inside Q_i→o.
